quotes.text: The 1835 Great Moon Hoax sold out the New York Sun every day for a week.
Hearst and Pulitzer manufactured a war over the USS Maine in 1898.
The United Daughters of the Confederacy vetted Southern history textbooks for decades.
In 1898, newspapers engineered the only successful coup d'état on US soil.
Zola's 'J'accuse…!' sold 200,000 copies in Paris in a single day.
The Protocols of the Elders of Zion was forged by the Tsarist secret police in 1903.
